Respect for human rights: We fully respect human rights as defined by international standards.
Environmental protection: We strive to minimize our environmental footprint by conserving natural resources and adopting environmentally-friendly practices.
Social commitment: We strive to improve the quality of working life for our employees and contribute to the sustainable development of our communities.
Economic commitment: We support the economic development of the regions in which we operate, while respecting the principles of CSR.
Transparency and integrity: We are committed to acting transparently, ethically and responsibly in all our actions.
